Hi Alex — thanks for flagging and for sending the onboarding form.

Quick update: PO 00012345 was issued from a provisional queue while the finance tag (billing_code: RBW-INTG-2026) was being reconciled — that caused the spend cap to default to $0 in export. Ive asked Finance to reissue with the correct spend bucket and to populate the four expected SKU line items (integration fee, sandbox hours, surge reserve, and monthly support).

Plan: I will request a reissue to include:
- Spend cap: $48,000 (trial + buffer)
- Line items: 4 (with unit qty and unit prices)
- Billing code: RBW-INTG-2026

Ill attach the revised PO when it's available and loop in Ben for any customer-facing credits we should pre-approve if fixed pricing needs to change. Expect a revised PO in 24 hours.

Monica Patel

Monica / Ben —
